Name: Hide Total Earnings
Author: RaptorReed
Description:
Very simple mod that just allows you to hide the "Total Earnings" that's usually displayed on the inventory tab. You can also hide the "Current Funds".

Enjoy the game without worrying how much money you've made/spent.

Downloads.Description: Adds option to hide Current Funds from inventory tab

Manifest.Name: Hide Total Earnings
Manifest.Description: Hides Total Earnings from inventory tab.
